name: degree_centrality
author: c52598eb
description: Ranks nodes by degree centrality: the number of direct connections a node has, divided by (n - 1). Use it for questions like 'Which airport has the most direct routes?', 'Which airports have the most departures (direction=out) or arrivals (direction=in)?' or 'Who has the most friends in the karate club?'. Works on directed and undirected graphs; edge weights are ignored. On a directed graph the score counts incoming plus outgoing edges by default, or only one direction. Returns the top_k nodes, highest first, each with id, label, score and its raw degree (plus in_degree and out_degree on directed graphs).

graph_id.description: Id of the graph to analyse.

top_k.description: How many of the most connected nodes to return.

direction.description: Directed graphs only: count incoming plus outgoing edges ('total'), only incoming ('in'), or only outgoing ('out'). Ignored on undirected graphs.
